name: Underwater — Ambient Current, Thermocline, Bounded Basin
description: Open-ocean conditions for fish (sardine, jellyfish): ambient horizontal current, vertical thermocline density gradient, bounded sphere (ocean volume).
notes: The thermocline acts as a preferred-depth layer for both sardines and jellyfish. Above it: warmer, less dense, oxygen-rich but food-poor. Below it: colder, denser, oxygen-limited. Both species aggregate near it, producing the characteristic depth-stratified bloom shapes observed by underwater cameras.
